//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Silkier Touch -> Config

Enable Silkier Touch.//: Whether Silkier Touch is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

enableDragonEggDrop.//: Disables the dragon egg teleport functionality when using a silk touch pickaxe.

enableSpawnerDrop.//: Enables monster spawners to drop with silk touch. It keeps the mob data.

enableTrialSpawnerDrop.//: Lowers the trial spawner 'strength' to allow breaking it. Will be dropped with silk touch on a pickaxe. Changing this requires a reboot.

enableFullCakeDrop.//: Allows cakes that haven't been eaten from to drop with silk touch. Works with candle cakes as well.

enableBuddedAmethystDrop.//: Allows Budded Amethyst to drop when mined with silk touch.

enableFarmlandDrop.//: Allows Farmland to drop when harvested with silk touch.

enableTallGrassDrop.//: Allows Tall Grass to drop when harvested with silk touch.

enableSnowLayerDrop.//: Allows Snow Layers to drop when harvested with silk touch.

enableVinesDrop.//: Allows Vines to drop when harvested with silk touch.

enableInfestedStoneDrop.//: Allows Infested Stone to drop when mined with silk touch.
